shots.title:
SAME STEEL.
DIFFERENT RESULT.
shots.action: The dimensional ship advances while the rigid nail descends into the ocean.

shots.title:
SAME VOLUME.
DIFFERENT MASS.
shots.action: The nail descends to align with an exact same-shape water volume; its geometry remains unchanged.

shots.title:
HOLLOW HULL.
DRY INTERIOR.
shots.action: A scan removes the actual ship's near plating to reveal dry interior ribs, preserving its silhouette and deck.

shots.title:
MORE LOAD.
MORE DISPLACEMENT.
shots.action: Cargo drops onto the deck; the same ship settles deeper while the excluded underwater volume grows.
